items.t: In Knight, Vancouver, houses sold at a median of $1,710,000 across 62 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,456,500 and $2,088,750. The median house sat 28 days and sold for 96.4% of list.
Knight, Vancouver: 11 townhomes sold at a median of $1,100,000, with the middle half between $1,034,400 and $1,313,500. The median townhome took 5 days to sell and closed at 99.1% of list.

17 condos sold in Knight, Vancouver at a median of $673,000 (middle half $547,000 to $725,000). A typical condo in Knight, Vancouver spent 35 days on the market and closed at 96.3% of the asking price.
In Knight, Vancouver, duplexes sold at a median of $1,496,500 across 40 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,348,250 and $1,733,500. The median duplex sat 20 days and sold for 96.8% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Knight compares with the rest of Vancouver East

items.t: Of 15 Vancouver East sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Knight ranks 7th highest at $1,710,000; the range is $1,510,000 (Collingwood) to $1,980,000 (Fraser). South Vancouver ($1,675,000) sits just below and Mount Pleasant VE ($1,835,000) sits just above.

Townhomes in Knight have the 6th highest median of 13 Vancouver East sub-areas, $1,100,000. Killarney is lowest at $796,000 and Main highest at $1,419,500. Grandview-Woodland ($1,085,000) sits just below and Fraser ($1,144,000) sits just above.

Of 13 Vancouver East sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Knight ranks 5th highest at $673,000; the range is $520,000 (Collingwood) to $898,950 (Main). Grandview-Woodland ($664,900) sits just below and Mount Pleasant VE ($698,500) sits just above.

Duplexes in Knight have the 5th highest median of 15 Vancouver East sub-areas, $1,496,500. Strathcona is lowest at $1,112,500 and Main highest at $1,919,000. Hastings Sunrise ($1,492,000) sits just below and Grandview-Woodland ($1,585,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, duplexes are the newest homes selling in Knight, Vancouver (median 2025) and houses the oldest (median 1964), a gap of 61 years.
